scope: Recovery top-up of local.plcsim_gaps.20261029: scripts/qualify_plcsim_gaps.py on a frozen Debug build of ad7096c (artifacts/gs4), 74/74 steps, same fixture and checks on one owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU1511 instance on Softbus. Added after the reinitialized online download: change_status keeps its applied state and checkpoint archive; change_restore retrieves the checkpoint into a new directory while the CPU keeps the downloaded program (ProgramVersion 2, reinitialized counter 0); a simulation_download_online prepared from the recovered copy refuses with SimulationTargetMismatch, because that copy is not the project that produced the instance's card; plc_online_compare of the recovered project reports FolderContentsIdentical (the checkpoint was taken after the layout change and before its download). Every other step of the 29 October run (code change keeping values, kept and reinitialized layout changes, virtual time, OB82/OB83/OB86, memory reset, storage archive and retrieve) passed again.
limitations: One owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU1511 instance on Softbus of a scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1; other CPUs, firmware and TCP/IP instances are not qualified.
The online download is a CPU write: change_restore recovers only the project, and the recovered copy can no longer download to the instance whose card came from the original project.
OB40 stays a V21 boundary (no hardware-interrupt configuration through V21 Openness; PLCSIM answers NotSupportedByModule).

steps: ET 200SP station on the CPU's IO system

refresh the PLCSIM tag list after code change
